title: Notation spec: Go board coordinates
description:
Go coordinate notation for the notation adapter.

## Board coordinates (primary)
Column letters A-T skipping I (avoids confusion with J), row numbers 1-19.
Examples: Q16, D4, K10, A1

## SGF coordinates (secondary)
Two lowercase letters: aa=top-left (A19 in board coords), ss=bottom-right (T1).
Column a-s = A-T, row a-s = 19-1 (inverted).

## Grid labels
files: ["A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H","J","K","L","M","N","O","P","Q","R","S","T"]
ranks: [19,18,...,1] (or [1,...,19] with row inversion)
Note: no "I" column — this is universal in Go.

## Special moves
- pass → {"action_type": "pass"}
- resign → {"action_type": "resign"}

## Board sizes
9x9, 13x13, 19x19 all use the same notation, just with fewer columns/rows.

## Declarative spec
```json
"notation": {
  "piece_symbols": {"stone": ""},
  "special_moves": {
    "pass": {"action_type": "pass"},
    "resign": {"action_type": "resign"}
  }
}
```
Covered by Layer 1 label mapping + special moves. No disambiguation needed (placement only). No WASM needed.
